summary: A TypeScript library (in memory, Node 20.3+, fake providers only -- nothing is ever really sent) for the core of a notification system, built in three stages on top of three sibling libraries used as file: dependencies (resilience-kit from projects/18-resilience: exponentialBackoff, TimeoutPolicy, CircuitBreaker; ratelimit-kit from projects/19-rate-limit: RateLimiter with slidingWindow; cache-kit from projects/20-cache: LruCache). Stage 1, the LLD core: a NotificationCatalog of types as data (category transactional or marketing, an ordered channel list, mode all or first, exactly one template per channel, a subject for email only), all checked at registration; {{name}} / {{a.b}} templates where a missing, null or undefined value is an error, only own properties are read, email bodies (and only they) are HTML-escaped and values are never rendered again; user preferences (marketing mutes per channel, quiet hours HH:MM in the user's local time from a fixed UTC offset, start inclusive, end exclusive, may cross midnight); the whole rule in one function planChannel (no address -> skipped no_address; transactional ignores mutes and quiet hours; marketing muted -> opted_out; marketing SMS / push in quiet hours -> deferred to the end of the window; email never deferred); channels as a Strategy (ChannelSender, a throwing or garbage-returning sender is a retryable failure); mode all (every channel in parallel) and first (in order, the first success wins, the rest not_needed); idempotency keys registered in the synchronous part of notify() before any await (20 concurrent duplicates -> one record, one send; same key with another payload -> IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, key order inside data ignored); check everything then change state (an error means nothing was stored and the key is still free); and flushDue for deferred deliveries, which plans a due delivery AGAIN at send time -- found by the randomized test: a late flush sent a marketing push inside the NEXT night's quiet hours. Stage 2, the HLD half: QueuedNotifier (notify validates, stores, queues and returns; workers send) on a shared planner.ts; an InMemoryJobQueue with leases (visibility timeout, lease token checked before every write, at-least-once, a stable provider idempotency key <notificationId>:<channel>), strict priorities (transactional 0 before marketing 1, then runAt, then FIFO), retries as delayed jobs with exponential backoff and full jitter (default 3 attempts), a TimeoutPolicy per provider call and a CircuitBreaker per channel (only retryable failures counted; circuit open: first fails over at once, all waits for the probe without using an attempt), quiet-hour deferrals as delayed jobs planned again when they run, marketing frequency caps per user and channel on the first try only (over the cap -> skipped capped; cap store down -> the job waits), idempotency keys in an LRU with a 24 h TTL and 100 000 entries, and a Worker with start / stop / drain; using the libraries showed they built without type declarations (fixed with declaration: true) and that a cap of 1/day with the sliding window counter blocks for 36 h (pinned in a test). Stage 3: an Express 4.22.3 HTTP API (4.21.2's body-parser, path-to-regexp and qs have advisories) with a required API key (>= 16 chars, SHA-256 digests compared with timingSafeEqual, checked before the body is parsed), POST /notifications with a required Idempotency-Key (202 + Location, 200 + Idempotent-Replayed, 409), GET /notifications/:id, GET / PUT preferences for known users only (shape checked: quietHours null was a TypeError), errors by whose fault (400/401/404/409/413/415/422, 500 hidden and logged) and a graceful startServer close; signed delivery-receipt webhooks POST /webhooks/:channel (Notify-Signature t=,v1= HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp and the raw body, 5 min tolerance, verified before parsing, registered before the API-key check) whose state only moves up a ranking (delivered < bounced, ties keep the earlier time) so order and duplicates cannot matter, early receipts parked in an LRU for 1 h, a bounce counting as failed; several push devices per user (pushTokens fanned out at send time, a call and key <id>:push:<token> per device, sent if any device accepted, retries only to devices that did not fail for good, attempts = rounds, dead tokens with invalidAddress removed, at most 10 tokens); and an in-app inbox as a fourth channel in_app (opaque canonical cursor paging newest first, a stored unread counter changed only on a real state change, mark all read up to the newest item seen, idempotent on the provider key, per-user lookups, 200 items per user). 192 tests (stage 1: 81, stage 2 added 45, stage 3 added 66), including randomized invariant tests (8 seeds x 300 requests; 6 seeds x 250 requests with 3 workers that die holding jobs; 300 shuffled receipt lists; 2000 random inbox operations). Mutation checks, each break applied alone with the file restored byte for byte: stage 1 43, stage 2 77 (the 43 moved plus 34 new), HTTP API 25, receipts 24, devices 21, inbox 20 -- 167 distinct breaks, all caught after closing the documented first-run survivors (Q5, C2; S22, S24, W2; H15; D4, D6). Not built: a database, a real broker, real providers, DST via IANA zones, suppression lists, fallback after a bounce, multicast push, per-device preferences, aging for priorities, per-user auth, a WebSocket / SSE inbox.

pitch.intro_30s: Maine ek notification system ka core banaya hai, TypeScript mein, in memory, fake providers ke saath. Stage 1 LLD hai: notification types catalog mein, templates, user preferences aur quiet hours, push fail ho toh SMS par fallback, aur idempotency taaki retry par OTP do baar na jaaye. Stage 2 HLD: leases wali job queue, workers, backoff ke saath retries, per-channel circuit breaker, frequency caps. Stage 3: HTTP API, signed delivery receipts, multiple push devices aur in-app inbox. 192 tests, 167 mutation checks, sab caught.
pitch.explain_2min:
'Design a notification system' interview mein do tarah poocha jaata hai: LLD round (classes, templates, preferences) aur HLD round (queues, workers, retries). Mushkil follow-ups mein hai: user ne opt out kiya, user ke yahan raat ke 3 baje hain, push fail hua toh SMS, client ne request retry ki toh OTP do baar nahi jaana chahiye. Maine teeno stages mein yahi cheezein chhote, tested rules banayi.

Stage 1: notification TYPE data hai, class nahi -- category (transactional ya marketing), channels ka order, mode aur har channel ka template, registration par validate. Poora rule ek function planChannel mein: address nahi toh skip; transactional mutes aur quiet hours ignore karta hai (muted OTP user ko lock out kar dega); marketing muted channel skip karta hai, aur quiet hours mein SMS / push ko window ke end tak defer. Mode 'first' mein pehli success jeet-ti hai, baaki not_needed. Idempotency key notify() ke synchronous hisse mein register hoti hai, kisi await se pehle -- 20 concurrent duplicates, ek record, ek send.

Stage 2: notify() ab send nahi karta, queue karta hai aur turant lautata hai. Queue mein leases hain: worker mar jaaye toh lease khatam hone par job doosre worker ko milti hai -- at-least-once, isliye har send par stable provider idempotency key. Retries delayed jobs hain backoff ke saath, worker mein sleep nahi. Har channel ka apna circuit breaker aur timeout, marketing par per-user frequency cap, aur idempotency keys 24 h TTL wale LRU mein. Yeh teeno cheezein maine apni hi pichhli libraries se li: resilience-kit, ratelimit-kit, cache-kit.

Stage 3: Express API ek API key ke saath, POST /notifications par required Idempotency-Key (202, replay par 200, conflict 409). Providers ke delivery receipts signed webhooks se aate hain, aur receipt state sirf upar jaati hai, toh out-of-order aur duplicates fark nahi daalte. Ek user ke kai push devices, dead tokens automatically remove. Aur in-app inbox ek chautha channel hai, cursor paging aur unread counter ke saath.

192 tests, jismein randomized invariant tests bhi hain jo workers ko beech mein maarte hain, aur 167 mutation checks -- sab caught.
pitch.deep_5min:
Ek marketing 'sale' notification ki journey, HTTP se phone aur inbox tak.

Request. Ek service POST /notifications bhejti hai: Authorization: Bearer <key>, Idempotency-Key: sale-u1-42, body { typeId: 'sale', userId: 'u1', data: { pct: 20 } }. createApp mein pehle webhook route registered hai (uski baat baad mein), phir auth middleware -- body parse hone se PEHLE, taaki unauthenticated caller ke liye hum JSON parse bhi na karein. Key ko SHA-256 digest karke timingSafeEqual se compare karte hain, toh na content na length timing se leak hoti hai. Phir express.json 64 KB limit ke saath, Content-Type check (warna 415), header aur field types (warna 400).

New ya replay. Handler pehle notifier.getByKey(key) karta hai, phir notifier.notify(). Dono synchronous hain, beech mein kuch nahi chal sakta, toh agar key pehle unknown thi aur ab record mila, yeh request NEW hai: 202 + Location. Pehle se tha toh 200 + Idempotent-Replayed: true. Same key, alag payload (fingerprint stableStringify se, key order ignore) -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

notify(). checkRequest key aur data check karta hai; buildRecord type aur user dhundhta hai, HAR channel ka template render karta hai (chahe yeh user use skip kare -- validity user ya time par depend nahi karni chahiye), aur har channel par planChannel chalata hai. Yahan tak koi state nahi badli; error ho toh kuch store nahi hua aur key free hai. Phir record store, key LRU mein, aur jobs queue: mode 'all' mein har pending delivery ki job abhi, har deferred ki job notBefore par; 'first' mein sirf ek candidate. Priority: marketing 1, transactional 0 -- ek OTP kitne bhi promotions ke baad queue ho, pehle claim hota hai.

Worker. Worker.runOnce claim(concurrency) karta hai: InMemoryJobQueue ready jobs (runAt aa gaya, lease nahi ya expired) priority, runAt, FIFO se sort karke leaseToken aur leaseUntil deta hai. process() kabhi throw nahi karta; unexpected error par job leased rehti hai aur lease khatam hone par phir aati hai -- crashed worker wala hi path.

processJob. Step 1: delivery already finished hai (worker complete se pehle mara) toh job drop. Step 2: replan -- stage 1 ka sabak. Job ghanto wait kar sakti hai; tab tak user ne mute kiya ho, address badla ho, ya raat ho gayi ho. Stage 1 mein pehli version jo due tha bhej deti thi, aur randomized test ne pakda ki late flush ne agli raat ki quiet hours mein marketing push bhej diya. Ab deferred plan par job reschedule hoti hai window ke end tak. Step 3: marketing ka frequency cap, sirf pehli try par (admitted set), key userId:channel. Over the cap -> skipped capped, defer nahi -- purane promotions ka backlog kisi kaam ka nahi. Cap store down -> job wait karti hai, na bina cap send na drop. Aur await ke baad lease check -- yahi S22 tha: bina check ke ek stalled worker ne naye owner ki SENT delivery par 'pending' likh diya.

Step 4: send. Push ke liye sendToAddresses user ke CURRENT tokens padhta hai aur har device ko parallel call, har call breaker.execute(timeout.execute(...)) ke andar, har ek ki apni key id:push:token. Retryable failure ProviderFailure throw karke breaker ko gini jaati hai; permanent failure (galat number) provider ka sahi kaam hai, gini nahi jaati. Results fold: koi device accept kare toh sent; sab circuit-open toh circuit-open; koi retryable ho toh retry sirf un devices ko jo permanently fail nahi hue; warna failed. invalidAddress wala permanent failure token user se hata deta hai -- turant, lease ho ya na ho, kyunki token dono haalat mein dead hai. D4 yahin tha: retryable failure par invalidAddress se working token hat jaata.

Step 5: lease check, phir likhna. Device log tabhi likha jaata hai. Circuit open: 'first' turant agle channel par (D6: multi-device par sab refused ko ordinary retryable maana tha, OTP 30 s wait karta), 'all' probe ke time tak requeue bina attempt khaaye. Retryable aur attempts bache -> reschedule now + backoff. Sent -> sentBy index mein providerId, aur agar receipt pehle aa chuki thi (parked) toh merge.

Inbox. Isi sale ka in_app channel InboxSender se InMemoryInbox mein item banata hai, provider key id:in_app par idempotent. Quiet hours ise defer nahi karte -- yeh kisi ko jagata nahi.

Receipt. Baad mein provider POST /webhooks/push bhejta hai, Notify-Signature: t=..,v1=HMAC(secret, t + '.' + raw body). Raw bytes par verify, parse se pehle, 5 min tolerance. mergeReceipt: delivered < bounced, tie par earlier time -- yeh max function hai, toh order aur duplicates fark nahi karte, seen-event-id store ki zaroorat nahi.

Sabse mushkil decisions: retries queue mein (worker slot nahi rokte, crash survive karte), leaseMs > sendTimeoutMs enforced, circuit open par mode ke hisaab se alag behaviour, aur push devices ek delivery (ek channel) ke andar fan-out, alag deliveries nahi.
pitch.architecture_walkthrough: src/types.ts: CHANNELS (email, sms, push, in_app), categories, DeliveryStatus, SkipReason (no_address, opted_out, not_needed, capped), Recipient, OutboundMessage, SendResult (sent with providerId, ya failed with retryable, reason, optional invalidAddress), addressesFor / addressFor (in_app ka address user id). src/catalog.ts: NotificationCatalog.register -- id format, category, mode, channels known aur repeat nahi, har listed channel ka exactly ek template, subject sirf email (aur in_app title) ke liye, malformed {{ refuse; copy store hoti hai. src/template.ts: placeholders, renderText, renderTemplate, escapeHtml (& pehle) -- missing value error, own properties only, re-render nahi. src/preferences.ts: PreferenceStore (untrusted shape check, copies), quietUntil (local time, midnight-crossing window, negative epoch ke liye double modulo). src/policy.ts: planChannel -- poora rule, WAKES_USER = sms, push. src/senders.ts: ChannelSender strategy aur FakeSender. src/users.ts: InMemoryUsers -- UserDirectory aur PushTokenRegistry, MAX_PUSH_TOKENS 10, checkPushToken. src/record.ts: NotificationRecord, Delivery, DeviceResult, notificationStatus (bounced = failed), markRestNotNeeded. src/planner.ts: dono notifiers ka shared hissa -- checkRequest + stableStringify fingerprint, buildRecord (sab check, koi state change nahi), replan, outboundMessage (provider idempotency key), sendOnce (throw / garbage = retryable), recordResult, sendToAddresses + pushTargets + deviceLog (fan-out aur dead-token removal). src/notifier.ts: stage 1 Notifier -- in-process sends, idempotency map, flushDue jo due delivery replan karta hai aur running set se busy record skip karta hai. src/queue.ts: JobQueue interface (enqueue, claim, owns, complete, reschedule) aur InMemoryJobQueue -- priority / runAt / FIFO, lease tokens, O(n) claim. src/queued-notifier.ts: QueuedNotifier -- PRIORITY, leaseMs > sendTimeoutMs check, per-channel CircuitBreaker, TimeoutPolicy, exponentialBackoff, keys aur parked LruCache, admitted set, sentBy index, notify / claim / process / processJob / applyReceipt / queueNextCandidate / retryLater. src/worker.ts: Worker -- runOnce, drain, start (ek hi loop, unref'd idle timer), stop (chal rahe jobs ka wait). src/receipts.ts: mergeReceipt (rank aur tie rule), signWebhook, verifyWebhook (anchored regex, tolerance, timingSafeEqual). src/inbox.ts: InMemoryInbox (per-user Box with items, byId, byKey, unread), encodeCursor / decodeCursor (base64url v1.<seq>, canonical only), InboxSender. src/http/app.ts: createApp -- webhook route (express.raw) API-key middleware se pehle, keyMatches, express.json 64 KB, notifications, preferences, push-tokens, inbox routes, 404 fallback, toHttp error mapping (500 message hidden aur logged). src/http/server.ts: startServer -- API + worker, close() requests phir sends finish karta hai, port in use par reject. src/main.ts: npm start wiring (env se key aur webhook secrets, fake senders, demo user; test nahi hota). src/demo.ts, src/demo-queue.ts: stage 1 aur stage 2 demos. test/: helpers.ts aur queued-helpers.ts (manual clock, fakes), aur 15 test files, 192 tests: template 9, catalog 17, policy 12, notifier 29, idempotency 7, invariants 8, queue 5, queued 29, worker 5, queued-invariants 6, http 22, server 2, receipts 10, devices 16, inbox 15. scripts/build-deps.mjs: teeno sibling libraries ko build karta hai.
difficult_decisions: Category decide karti hai kaunse preferences lagte hain. Transactional (OTP, password reset, receipt) mutes aur quiet hours dono ignore karta hai, sirf missing address skip karata hai; marketing mutes maanta hai aur raat mein SMS / push defer karta hai, email nahi (email kisi ko jagata nahi). User ko sab kuch mute karne dena simple lagta, lekin muted OTP user ko lock out kar deta. Aur quiet hours DROP nahi, DEFER karte hain -- aur deferred delivery bhejne ke time phir se plan hoti hai, kyunki wait ke dauraan time, preferences aur address badal jaate hain.

Retries queue mein delayed jobs hain (runAt = now + backoff), worker ke andar sleep nahi -- isliye resilience-kit ka RetryPolicy yahan use nahi kiya, sirf uska exponentialBackoff, TimeoutPolicy aur CircuitBreaker. In-process retry wait karte hue worker slot rokta hai aur process ke saath kho jaata hai; queued retry wait mein kuch kharch nahi karta aur crash survive karta hai. Saath mein leases (visibility timeout) 'processing' flag ki jagah: crash flag ko hamesha set chhod deta. Iska matlab at-least-once, toh har send par stable provider idempotency key, aur leaseMs > sendTimeoutMs constructor mein enforce, taaki healthy slow send doosre worker ko na mile.

Circuit open par behaviour mode ke hisaab se. 'first' turant agle channel par fail over karta hai -- 'first' exist hi isliye karta hai ki dead channel ke around route kare, OTP ko 30 s wait nahi karna chahiye. 'all' ko har channel tak pahunchna hai, toh woh probe allow hone tak requeue hota hai BINA attempt khaaye -- jab provider call hui hi nahi toh attempts jalana bina ek real try ke delivery fail kar deta. Aur sirf retryable failures breaker ko gine jaate hain: permanent failure (galat number) provider ka sahi kaam hai.

Multiple push devices ek delivery ke andar fan-out, har device ki alag delivery nahi. 'first' mode ka matlab 'pehla channel jo user tak pahunche' hai, aur phone + tablet ek channel hain, do nahi. Tokens job CHALNE par padhe jaate hain (beech mein register hua device retry paata hai), har device ki apni key <id>:push:<token> (ek delivery key hoti toh provider doosre device ka message duplicate maan ke drop kar deta), aur attempt = ek round of calls, taaki maxAttempts ka matlab rounds hi rahe.

Receipts ka order aur duplicates DATA se handle, seen event ids ke store se nahi. Receipt sirf ek ranking mein upar jaati hai (delivered < bounced; email accept ho ke baad mein bounce ho sakta hai), tie par earlier time. Yeh maximum hai -- associative, commutative, idempotent -- toh kisi bhi order aur kitni bhi copies ka result same (randomized test). Dedup store extra state hota aur distinct-but-out-of-order events handle nahi karta. Jo receipt send result se pehle aa jaaye woh 404 nahi, 1 h ke liye parked (202), kyunki har provider 4xx retry nahi karta.

HTTP par status codes 'kiski galti' se: 400 malformed, 422 well-formed but impossible (unknown type ya user, missing template variable), 415 not JSON, 413 over 64 KB, 500 hamari galti (channel bina sender) message hidden aur logged. API key required, koi open mode nahi -- open notification API ek free SMS-spam service hai. Webhook route API-key check se PEHLE registered hai, kyunki providers ke paas hamari key nahi hoti aur hamari key receipts sign nahi karti; signature raw bytes par, parse se pehle.
biggest_challenges: Late flush jo agli raat ki quiet hours mein bhej deta tha -- randomized invariant test ne pakda, haath ke tests ne nahi. Stage 1 ki pehli flushDue jo bhi due tha bhej deti thi. Lekin flushDue polled hai; agar woh late chale (agli shaam), toh ek marketing push jo subah 07:00 ke liye deferred tha agli raat 23:00 par chala jaata, aur jo user ne beech mein channel mute kiya use bhi message mil jaata. Fix: due delivery bhejne ke time planChannel phir chalta hai (replan) -- send, defer again ya skip. Yahi sabak stage 2 mein har job ka step 2 bana, aur mutations N5 / S5 (no replan) isko guard karte hain.

S22: lease check ek await ke baad chhoot gaya tha. Frequency cap ka store fail hota hai toh worker job ko baad ke liye reschedule karta hai. Agar worker us failing store par lease se zyada atak gaya, job doosre worker ko mil chuki thi aur usne SEND bhi kar diya -- phir purane worker ne us SENT delivery par 'pending' aur 'frequency cap unavailable' likh diya. Pehli mutation run mein yeh check hatane wala break survive kar gaya kyunki koi test is order ko nahi chalata tha; test add hua. Sabak: har await ke baad, har write se pehle owns(id, token, now). Usi run mein S24 (skipped retry par nextAttemptAt reh gaya) aur W2 (start() do baar, test doosra loop dekh hi nahi pata tha -- ab concurrency 1 se check) bhi test gaps the.

Libraries ko consume karne par unki khamiyan dikhi. Pehli: resilience-kit, ratelimit-kit aur cache-kit teeno bina type declarations ke build hote the, toh is TypeScript consumer ko types hi nahi milte the -- har library ke tsconfig.build.json mein declaration: true. Doosri: ratelimit-kit ka sliding window counter previous day-aligned window ko weight karta hai, toh 1/day cap ke saath 12:00 ka send do din baad 00:00 UTC tak block karta hai -- 36 h. Yeh bug nahi, algorithm ka trade-off hai; test mein pin kiya aur README mein likha ki exact '24 h since the last one' ke liye sliding log chahiye.

Multi-device ke do survivors, D4 aur D6. D4: provider ne retryable failure (jaise 503) ke saath invalidAddress flag bheja toh working token remove ho jaata -- 503 device ke baare mein kuch nahi kehta; ab removal sirf permanent + invalidAddress par. D6: jab har device ki call open circuit ne refuse ki, use ordinary retryable failure maana gaya, toh OTP 'first' mode mein SMS par fail over karne ki jagah wait karta -- stage 2 ka circuit-open path multi-device par chhoot gaya tha kyunki kisi multi-device test ne breaker open hi nahi kiya. Dono ke liye tests add hue.

HTTP layer ne library ki assumptions todi. PreferenceStore.set typed input maanta tha; HTTP body { quietHours: null } bheje toh TypeError aata, jo 500 ban jaata. Ab shape check hota hai aur INVALID_PREFERENCES (422). H15: PUT preferences unknown user ke liye store ho jaate the (typo wala id kabhi apply nahi hota) -- koi test aisa PUT bhejta hi nahi tha; test add. Aur Express 4.21.2 (project 20 wala) ke body-parser, path-to-regexp aur qs par published advisories thi; yahan Express runtime dependency hai, toh 4.22.3 (npm audit --omit=dev: 0).
failure_scenarios: Worker mar jaaye ya lease se zyada atak jaaye: lease khatam hone par job doosre worker ko milti hai aur woh dobara bhejta hai (at-least-once). Purane worker ke late writes refuse hote hain kyunki har write se pehle owns(id, token, now) check hota hai. Agar purana worker bhej chuka tha, toh duplicate provider tak jaata hai -- same provider idempotency key ke saath, jise idempotency support karne wala provider drop karta hai. Yahan ke fakes dedupe nahi karte; tests key check karte hain. Worker result likh ke complete se pehle mara toh redelivered job 'already finished' dekh ke drop hoti hai.

Provider down ya hang: har call TimeoutPolicy (default 10 s) se bounded, timeout retryable failure hai aur sender ka signal abort hota hai. Retries backoff ke saath (1 s, 2 s, ... max 5 min, full jitter), default 3 attempts, phir failed aur 'first' mein agla channel. Failure rate threshold cross ho toh us channel ka breaker open: koi provider call nahi, 'first' turant fail over, 'all' probe tak wait bina attempt khaaye.

Frequency cap ka store (Redis) down: job wait karti hai aur backoff ke baad phir try -- na bina cap ke send (spam), na drop, koi attempt use nahi. Agar wait ke dauraan lease kho gayi toh late error naye owner ke result par nahi likha jaata (S22 fix). Transactional par cap kabhi lagta hi nahi, toh OTP is outage se affect nahi hota.

Process restart: sab kuch in memory hai -- records, queue, idempotency keys, parked receipts, inbox. Restart par queued aur deferred jobs kho jaate hain, aur restart ke baad same Idempotency-Key ek NAYA notification banati hai. close() sirf graceful shutdown deta hai (requests aur chal rahe sends finish), queued jobs persist nahi hote. Production mein queue broker ya Postgres table mein, records database mein.

Webhook attacks aur weirdness: bina signature, galat secret, doosre channel ka secret, ya API key -> 401; 5 min se purana (captured request ka replay) ya future timestamp -> 401; body ya timestamp ka ek byte badla -> 401. Signature parse se pehle check hota hai, toh unsigned garbage 401 hai, 400 nahi. Duplicate ya out-of-order receipts state ko nuksaan nahi karte (max merge). Unknown provider id 1 h parked rehta hai, phir expire; parked LRU 10 000 entries par bounded.

Marketing starvation aur quiet-hour edge cases: priorities strict hain, toh constant transactional load mein marketing jobs wait karti rehti hain (aging nahi bana). Fixed UTC offset ki wajah se DST zone ka user saal ke aadhe hisse ek ghanta off hai. Stage 1 ka flushDue polled hai, toh chhota gap (jaise quiet 00:15-00:00) miss ho sakta hai aur message ek din aur wait karta hai; stage 2 mein delayed jobs se yeh poll nahi hai.
improvements: Persistence: records, idempotency keys aur inbox ek database mein (records ke liye retention period, keys ke liye unique constraint), aur queue ek real broker par -- SQS (visibility timeout), BullMQ, ya Postgres table jo FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED se claim ho. JobQueue interface already yahi shape hai (claim with lease, complete / reschedule with token); claim() abhi O(n) scan hai. Saath mein worker ek slot-based pool ho jo har free slot turant refill kare, batch ka wait na kare.

Real providers: SES / Twilio / FCM / APNs adapters ChannelSender ke peeche, unke error codes ko retryable / permanent / invalidAddress mein map karke, provider ki idempotency key support ke saath, aur push ke liye provider ka multicast API (ek request mein kai tokens). Abhi sab fakes hain aur kuch bhi bahar nahi jaata.

Suppression list aur bounce handling: bounced address par aage bhejna band, bounce ke baad agle channel par fallback, opened / clicked events, aur invalid email ya phone number ko bhi remove karna (abhi sirf push tokens remove hote hain). sentBy index bhi records ki tarah trim nahi hota.

Time zones: fixed UTC offset ki jagah IANA zone (Asia/Kolkata, America/New_York) store karna aur Intl ya tz library se local time nikalna, taaki DST mein quiet hours sahi rahein. Saath mein marketing ke liye opt-in model jahan law maange -- yeh planChannel mein ek policy change hai.

Auth aur fairness: abhi ek service API key hai; per-caller keys aur scopes, aur inbox ke liye end-user auth (abhi app backend ko check karna padta hai ki logged-in user hi :userId hai). Priorities mein aging, taaki marketing transactional load mein starve na ho. Per-device preferences (tablet mute) bhi nahi hain.

Real-time inbox: abhi app unread count poll karta hai; naye items ke liye WebSocket ya SSE push, items delete / archive, inbox 'read' ka feedback notification record mein, aur time-based expiry. Saath mein metrics (queue depth, lease losses, breaker state) ko real dashboard par export karna -- abhi sirf stats objects hain.

learning_path.concept: One rule for preferences: planChannel and quiet hours
steps: 1. Concept: ek channel ke liye decision -- send now, defer, ya skip -- category, preferences, address aur user ke local time se. Quiet hours start inclusive, end exclusive, midnight cross kar sakte hain.
2. Project need: user ne opt out kiya, uske yahan raat ke 3 baje hain, uska koi phone number nahi -- yeh sab follow-ups ek jagah tested hone chahiye, notifier mein bikhre nahi.

3. Code/API: policy.ts planChannel(category, channel, recipient, prefs, now) -> pending / deferred(notBefore) / skipped(reason); preferences.ts quietUntil(now, utcOffsetMinutes, quiet); PreferenceStore.set / get.

4. Detail: no address pehle (har category); transactional turant pending; marketing muted -> opted_out (quiet hours se pehle, opted out jeet-ta hai); WAKES_USER = sms, push, email aur in_app kabhi defer nahi; quietUntil local = now + offset, double modulo se 1970 se pehle bhi sahi (mutation Q5); fixed offset, DST nahi.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/policy.test.ts -- 'uses the user's local time: 17:00 UTC is 22:30 at UTC+5:30', 'works for times before 1970 (negative epoch)', 'a muted channel is skipped even in quiet hours'.
6. Interviewer next: DST ke saath IANA zones kaise karoge, aur marketing ke liye opt-in law ho toh kya badlega?

learning_path.concept: Stage 1 core: catalog, templates, delivery modes and planning again at send time
steps: 1. Concept: notification type data hai (category, channels, mode, templates), class per type nahi. Mode 'all' har allowed channel parallel mein; 'first' order mein, pehli success jeet-ti hai aur baaki not_needed. Saari validation pehle, state change baad mein.

2. Project need: OTP push se, warna SMS, warna email; missing template startup par pakda jaaye; 'Your code is ' bina code ke kabhi na jaaye; aur deferred delivery ke wait ke dauraan time, mute aur address badal sakte hain.

3. Code/API: catalog.ts NotificationCatalog.register; template.ts renderTemplate, escapeHtml; planner.ts checkRequest, buildRecord, replan, sendOnce; notifier.ts Notifier.notify / flushDue; record.ts markRestNotNeeded, notificationStatus.

4. Detail: har listed channel ka exactly ek template, subject sirf email / in_app; missing / null / undefined value error, own properties only, sirf email body HTML-escaped; buildRecord HAR channel render aur sender check karta hai chahe user use skip kare (validity user ya time par depend nahi karti), error par kuch store nahi aur key free; throw ya garbage lautaane wala sender = retryable failure; flushDue busy record (running set) skip karta hai; pehli version late flush mein agli raat ki quiet hours mein push bhej deti thi -- randomized test ne pakda, replan se fix.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/template.test.ts test/catalog.test.ts test/notifier.test.ts -- 'errors mean nothing happened', 'a late flush that lands in the NEXT night's quiet hours defers again instead of sending', 'muted after it was deferred'.
6. Interviewer next: validity ko user-independent rakhna kyun zaroori hai, aur polled flushDue mein chhota quiet gap kaise miss hota hai (stage 2 delayed jobs isse kaise bachate hain)?

learning_path.concept: Idempotency: request keys, fingerprints and bounded memory
steps: 1. Concept: client ek request ko ek key deta hai; same key dobara aaye toh same result, naya kaam nahi. Same key alag payload ke saath = conflict.
2. Project need: client timeout par retry karta hai -- user ko OTP do baar nahi jaana chahiye; aur keys hamesha ke liye memory mein nahi reh sakti.

3. Code/API: planner.ts checkRequest + stableStringify (fingerprint, key order ignore); notifier.ts aur queued-notifier.ts notify(); QueuedNotifier options idempotency { ttlMs, maxEntries } (cache-kit LruCache); HTTP Idempotency-Key header.

4. Detail: key synchronous hisse mein register, kisi await se pehle -- JavaScript ek synchronous block ek saath chalata hai, toh 20 concurrent duplicates mein ek hi check paar karta hai; failed notification ka duplicate resend nahi karta (retry delivery ka kaam hai); 24 h TTL / 100 000 entries ke baad same key NAYA notification (Stripe jaisa trade-off); HTTP mein getByKey + notify dono synchronous, toh 202 vs 200 Idempotent-Replayed sahi decide hota hai.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/idempotency.test.ts test/queued.test.ts -t 'idempotency' -- '20 concurrent identical requests while the provider is slow', 'after the TTL the key is forgotten'.
6. Interviewer next: multiple API instances par yeh synchronous trick kaam nahi karegi -- database unique constraint ya Redis SET NX kaise lagaoge?

learning_path.concept: A job queue with leases, priorities and at-least-once delivery
steps: 1. Concept: lease (visibility timeout) = claim ki gayi job leaseMs ke liye invisible; worker mare toh job wapas aati hai. Isliye delivery at-least-once, exactly-once nahi.
2. Project need: notify() turant lautaaye (HTTP 202), slow provider caller ko na roke, aur worker crash par koi notification kho na jaaye.
3. Code/API: queue.ts JobQueue (enqueue, claim, owns, complete, reschedule) aur InMemoryJobQueue; worker.ts Worker runOnce / drain / start / stop; queued-notifier.ts PRIORITY.

4. Detail: ready = runAt aa gaya aur lease nahi / expired; order priority (transactional 0, marketing 1), runAt, FIFO; har claim par naya leaseToken; complete / reschedule sirf current token aur valid lease par; leaseMs > sendTimeoutMs constructor mein; har send par provider key <notificationId>:<channel> har attempt par same; S22 -- har await ke baad lease check; start() do baar ek hi loop (W2); stop() chal rahe job ka wait.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/queue.test.ts test/worker.test.ts test/queued.test.ts -t 'leases' -- 'a worker that stalls past its lease', 'cap store fails AFTER the worker lost its lease'.
6. Interviewer next: SQS / BullMQ / Postgres SKIP LOCKED par yeh interface kaise map hota hai, aur marketing starvation ke liye aging kaise karoge?

learning_path.concept: Retries, timeouts, a circuit breaker per channel and frequency caps
steps: 1. Concept: retry = backoff ke baad dobara try; timeout = har call bounded; circuit breaker = failing provider ko kuch der call band; frequency cap = per user, per channel marketing limit.
2. Project need: provider blips sambhalna, dead push provider par OTP ka SMS par turant jaana, aur users ko promotions ka spam na hona.

3. Code/API: QueuedNotifier options retry { maxAttempts, backoff }, sendTimeoutMs, breaker, frequencyCap (ratelimit-kit RateLimiter); processJob mein ProviderFailure, BrokenCircuitError, TimeoutError handling; retryLater.

4. Detail: retries delayed jobs hain, worker mein sleep nahi; sirf retryable failures breaker ko gine jaate hain; circuit open: 'first' fail over, 'all' requeue retryAfterMs par bina attempt; cap sirf marketing, sirf pehli try (admitted set), over cap -> skipped capped, store down -> wait; 1/day sliding window counter 36 h block karta hai (pinned).

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/queued.test.ts -t 'circuit breaker' aur -t 'caps' -- '"first": circuit open -> no provider call, fail over to sms immediately', 'cap of 1/day with the sliding window counter'; npm run demo:queue.
6. Interviewer next: breaker per channel vs per provider region kab, aur exact '24 h since last' cap ke liye sliding log kyun?

learning_path.concept: HTTP API: API key, idempotency over HTTP and status codes by whose fault
steps: 1. Concept: service-to-service API ek shared secret (Bearer key) se authenticate, constant-time compare; error codes caller ko batate hain ki galti kiski hai.
2. Project need: open notification API ek free SMS-spam service hai; aur caller ko pata hona chahiye ki retry kare (5xx) ya request theek kare (4xx).
3. Code/API: http/app.ts createApp({ apiKey, notifier, users, preferences, webhookSecrets, ... }), keyMatches, toHttp; http/server.ts startServer; main.ts (npm start).

4. Detail: key >= 16 chars, SHA-256 digests timingSafeEqual se (length bhi leak nahi); auth middleware express.json se pehle (broken JSON bina key = 401); 202 + Location, 200 + Idempotent-Replayed, 409; 400 / 413 / 415 / 422; 500 message hidden aur logged; preferences PUT whole replacement, known users only (H15); handlers synchronous kyunki Express 4 rejected promise ko error handler tak nahi le jaata; Express 4.22.3 advisories ki wajah se.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/http.test.ts test/server.test.ts -- '401 comes before the body is parsed', 'malformed requests -> 400 with a code; an error stores nothing', 'close() waits for the send in progress'.
6. Interviewer next: per-caller keys aur scopes kaise add karoge, aur end-user inbox access ke liye auth kahan hona chahiye?

learning_path.concept: Signed delivery-receipt webhooks and an order-independent merge
steps: 1. Concept: 'sent' sirf itna hai ki provider ne accept kiya; baad mein provider webhook se batata hai delivered ya bounced. HMAC signature se prove karta hai ki request usi ki hai.
2. Project need: koi bhi fake receipt bhej ke status na badal sake, captured request replay na ho, aur late, duplicate, out-of-order webhooks state na bigaadein.
3. Code/API: receipts.ts signWebhook, verifyWebhook, mergeReceipt; app.ts POST /webhooks/:channel (express.raw); QueuedNotifier.applyReceipt -> applied / unchanged / parked.

4. Detail: Notify-Signature t=<s>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw body)>, anchored regex, 5 min tolerance dono taraf, timingSafeEqual; raw bytes par kyunki re-serialized JSON match nahi karega; route API-key check se pehle; per-channel secret (nahi toh 404); rank delivered < bounced, tie par earlier time = max, toh dedup store nahi; early receipt parked LRU 1 h / 10 000; key channel + providerId; bounced delivery failed ginti hai.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/receipts.test.ts -- 'randomized: any order and any duplicates of the same events give the same result', 'a receipt that beats the send result is parked'; test/http.test.ts -t 'webhooks'.
6. Interviewer next: secret rotate kaise karoge (do secrets ek saath accept), aur bounce ke baad suppression list kahan banegi?

learning_path.concept: Several push devices: fan-out at send time and dead-token removal
steps: 1. Concept: ek user ke kai devices, har ek ka push token; ek push delivery sabko jaati hai. Provider token ko dead bataye (FCM UNREGISTERED, APNs 410) toh use hatao.
2. Project need: user phone badalta hai, reinstall karta hai, tablet use karta hai -- unregister kabhi nahi karta; dead tokens par bhejte rehna waste hai.
3. Code/API: users.ts InMemoryUsers (pushTokens, MAX_PUSH_TOKENS 10, checkPushToken, removePushToken); planner.ts sendToAddresses, pushTargets, deviceLog; HTTP POST / DELETE /users/:id/push-tokens.

4. Detail: tokens job chalne par padhe jaate hain; har device parallel, apne breaker + timeout ke through, key <id>:push:<token>; koi accept kare toh sent; sab circuit-open -> stage 2 ka circuit-open path (D6); retry sirf un devices ko jo permanently fail nahi hue; attempts = rounds (2 devices x 3 rounds = 6 calls, 3 attempts); removal sirf permanent + invalidAddress (D4), lease kho gayi ho tab bhi, device log sirf lease check ke baad; token list API kabhi echo nahi karti.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/devices.test.ts -- 'one device accepted, one dead', 'invalidAddress on a RETRYABLE failure is ignored', 'every device's call refused by an open circuit'.
6. Interviewer next: provider ka multicast API kab better hai, aur per-device preferences (tablet mute) kaise model karoge?

learning_path.concept: The in-app inbox: cursor paging and an unread counter that cannot drift
steps: 1. Concept: inbox ek chautha channel (in_app) hai jiska 'provider' message store karta hai. Cursor paging = 'is item se purane do', page number nahi; unread count ek stored counter.
2. Project need: bell icon ka count har page load par O(1) chahiye, naye items aate hue pages shift na hon, aur do tabs se mark read count do baar na ghataaye.
3. Code/API: inbox.ts InMemoryInbox (add, page, markRead, markAllRead, unreadCount), encodeCursor / decodeCursor, InboxSender; HTTP GET /users/:id/inbox, /unread-count, POST /:itemId/read, /read-all.

4. Detail: newest first, cursor base64url 'v1.<seq>', sirf canonical form accept (warna INVALID_CURSOR); limit 1..100 digits only; counter sirf real state change par (SQL shape: UPDATE ... WHERE read_at IS NULL); read-all upTo = user ne jo newest item dekha; add provider key <id>:in_app par idempotent; per-user lookup (doosre user ka item 404); 200 items per user, unread drop count ghataata hai; in_app ka address user id, quiet hours defer nahi karte, marketing mutes lagte hain.

5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npx vitest run test/inbox.test.ts -- 'items arriving between two pages do not shift the next page', 'randomized: after every operation the counter equals the unread items counted from scratch'.
6. Interviewer next: WebSocket / SSE se real-time push kaise jodoge (abhi polling), aur database mein counter ko row update ke saath ek transaction mein kaise rakhoge?

learning_path.concept: Testing honestly: randomized invariants and mutation checks
steps: 1. Concept: randomized invariant test = random requests, preferences, failures aur crashes chalao, aur har step par rules ko alag se compute karke check karo. Mutation check = jaan-boojh ke bug daalo aur dekho koi test fail hota hai ya nahi.
2. Project need: quiet hours x modes x retries x leases x devices ke combinations haath ke tests cover nahi karte, aur '192 tests pass' yeh nahi batata ki tests kuch pakadte hain.

3. Code/API: test/invariants.test.ts (8 seeds x 300 requests), test/queued-invariants.test.ts (6 seeds x 250 requests, 3 workers, dying workers), receipts aur inbox ke randomized tests; README ke mutation tables.

4. Detail: rules test mein Date arithmetic se re-compute, policy.ts se nahi; end par har job gone, har record finished, 'first' ne max ek channel bheja, attempts <= 3; mutations: stage 1 43, stage 2 77 (43 moved + 34 new), HTTP 25, receipts 24, devices 21, inbox 20 -- 167, sab caught; first-run survivors test gaps the (Q5, C2, S22, S24, W2, H15, D4, D6); J6 aur S6 hang se pakde jaate hain (180 s runner timeout).
5. Demo: cd projects/21-notification && npm test (192 tests), aur npx vitest run test/invariants.test.ts test/queued-invariants.test.ts.
6. Interviewer next: invariant test ka oracle implementation se independent kaise rakhoge, aur equivalent mutant kaise pehchanoge?
